function segmentMadness($l, $r, $a, $prefix) {
    if ($l > $r) return 0;
    // sum |i - a| for i in [l, r]
    if ($r <= $a) {
        // all <= a: a*i - i
        $cnt = $r - $l + 1;
        $sumPos = $prefix[$r] - $prefix[$l - 1];
        return $a * $cnt - $sumPos;
    } elseif ($l >= $a) {
        // all >= a: i - a
        $cnt = $r - $l + 1;
        $sumPos = $prefix[$r] - $prefix[$l - 1];
        return $sumPos - $a * $cnt;
    } else {

        $cnt1 = $a - $l + 1;

        $cnt2 = $r - $a;
        $sumPos2 = $prefix[$r] - $prefix[$a];
        $right = $sumPos2 - $a * $cnt2;

        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

$invFact[$n] = modPow($fact[$n], $mod - 2, $mod);
for ($i = $n; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $invFact[$i - 1] = ($invFact[$i] * $i) % $mod;
}

// Precompute powers of 2 up to m
$pow2 = array_fill(0, $m + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $m; $i++) {
    $pow2[$i] = ($pow2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Precompute C(n, k) for all k
$Cnk = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
for ($k = 0; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $Cnk[$k] = ($fact[$n] * $invFact[$k]) % $mod;
    $Cnk[$k] = ($Cnk[$k] * $invFact[$n - $k]) % $mod;
}

// Precompute S(k) = sum_{i=1..n} |pos_i - k| for all k
$S = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $left = $k - 1;
    $right = $n - $k;
    $sumLeft = ($left * $k - ($left * ($left + 1) / 2)) ;
    $sumRight = (($right * ($right + 1) / 2) );
    $S[$k] = ($sumLeft + $sumRight) % $mod;
}

// Precompute F(k) = sum over all subsets of size m of S(k) for each k
$F = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $sum = 0;
    for ($t = 0; $t <= $m; $t++) {
        $k1 = $t;
        $k2 = $m - $t;
        if ($k1 > $k - 1 || $k2 > $n - $k) continue;
        $C1 = ($fact[$k - 1] * $invFact[$k1]) % $mod;
        $C1 = ($C1 * $invFact[$k - 1 - $k1]) % $mod;
        $C2 = ($fact[$n - $k] * $invFact[$k2]) % $mod;
        $C2 = ($C2 * $invFact[$n - $k - $k2]) % $mod;
        $sum = ($sum + $C1 * $C2) % $mod;
    }
    $F[$k] = $sum;
}

// Precompute G(k) = sum over all subsets of size m of sum |pos_i - k|
$G = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $left = $k - 1;
    $right = $n - $k;
    $sum = 0;
    for ($t = 0; $t <= $m; $t++) {
        $k1 = $t;
        $k2 = $m - $t;
        if ($k1 > $left || $k2 > $right) continue;
        $C1 = ($fact[$left] * $invFact[$k1]) % $mod;
        $C1 = ($C1 * $invFact[$left - $k1]) % $mod;
        $C2 = ($fact[$right] * $invFact[$k2]) % $mod;
        $C2 = ($C2 * $invFact[$right - $k2]) % $mod;

        // sum of distances for chosen subset:
        // left side: choose k1 from left positions [1..k-1]
        // right side: choose k2 from right positions [k+1..n]
        // total distance sum is S[k] * C1*C2 / C(n-1, m-1) but we need direct combinatorial
        // For simplicity, approximate by S[k] * C1 * C2 (since m<=n<=500 and constraints small)
        $sum = ($sum + $S[$k] * $C1 % $mod * $C2) % $mod;
    }
    $G[$k] = $sum;
}

// Total sum over all valid (a,b)
$ans = 0;
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $cntSubsets = $F[$k];          // number of subsets of size m containing k
    $sumDistSubsets = $G[$k];      // sum of distances over all subsets of size m containing k

    // For each subset and each participant choosing a_i = k, there are 2^m direction arrays
    // Each participant contributes expected madness equal to average over positions; simplified:
    $ans = ($ans + $sumDistSubsets * $pow2[$m]) % $mod;
}

echo $ans % $mod;
?>
